title: bug: JetBrains chat shows no Approve/Reject decision cards after an IDE start or a reconnect, because ChatPanel requests decisions only once, before the daemon connection opens
description:
Files: moe-jetbrains/src/main/kotlin/com/moe/toolwindow/ChatPanel.kt, plus one of these routes:
- util/MoeJson.kt and model/Models.kt (if the fix reads decisions from the state snapshot), tested in moe-jetbrains/src/test/kotlin/com/moe/util/MoeJsonTest.kt;
- or a small headless-testable helper.
No open row declares any moe-jetbrains file. I checked the plan files of every non-DONE row at 2026-11-02 20:51Z.

Defect, read at HEAD 3e092cff:
- MoeToolWindowPanel builds ChatPanel (:303). Only afterwards does it start service.connect() on a pooled thread (:361-363).
- ChatPanel's constructor sends requestChannels() and requestDecisions() (:298-300). Before the socket opens, MoeCommandSender.ensureConnected (:26-33) drops both with a warning. requestDecisions is at :283-286.
- When the connection opens, ChatPanel.onStatus(true) (:214-219) re-requests channels only. ActivityLogPanel.onStatus (:80-84) re-requests its own data. ChatPanel does not re-request decisions.
- Nothing else repairs the map:
  - MoeJson.parseState (:310) ignores the snapshot's `decisions` array, which the daemon sends (packages/moe-daemon/src/state/StateManager.ts:1200).
  - The 3 s GET_STATE refresh also goes through parseState.
- So decisionsMap stays empty, and every existing `[Decision Proposed]` message renders as a plain bubble with no Approve/Reject buttons (the lookup at ChatPanel.kt:688).
- Only decisions proposed after the connection opens get cards, through DECISION_PROPOSED.
- Every daemon restart or reconnect repeats this for decisions proposed or resolved while the client was disconnected.

Reach: every IDE start with the Moe tool window open (the daemon is spawned after the panel is built) and every reconnect. These cards are JetBrains' only UI for approving or rejecting a decision.

Origin: hunt requested by governor-e6b40560 (msg-5fe3b1537cb04b50964bd0edf07db4c8). Rows 9cfb063f (decisions in chat) and VSC-6/VSC-22 never covered connect timing.

Fix direction: re-request decisions when the connection opens, as ActivityLogPanel does, and/or carry the snapshot's decisions through parseState into ChatPanel.onState, so the periodic refresh repairs the map. Choose at planning, and keep it headless-testable.
definitionOfDone: Every time the daemon connection opens, first connect and each reconnect, ChatPanel refills its decision map from the daemon. Either onStatus(connected=true) sends GET_DECISIONS, or onState reseeds the map from the snapshot's decisions parsed by MoeJson.parseState. Decisions that existed before the connection render as cards with Approve/Reject, with no channel switch and no new decision needed.

A headless JUnit 4 test covers the chosen mechanism. Examples: parseState returns the snapshot's decisions in order; or the connect handler issues GET_DECISIONS. Malformed decision entries are skipped and never throw. RED first against the unchanged code, with the failing output quoted in the completion evidence.

`cd moe-jetbrains && ./gradlew test` exits 0, run under the jetbrains-gradle lease (moe.acquire_resource, then release). From WSL, run `cmd.exe /c gradlew.bat test --rerun` in the task's checkout and label the evidence Windows. Its output is the complete_task evidence.
No daemon or VS Code file changes. Approve and Reject, DECISION_PROPOSED and DECISION_RESOLVED handling, and the channel and pin behaviour of ChatPanel are unchanged.

It records the name of every other callback it overrides (onState, onStatus, onError, onDaemonError, onDecisionProposed, onDecisionResolved) into `others`. Fixtures:

implementationPlan.description:
DECISIONS reply: skip malformed entries one at a time instead of dropping the whole list. This is in moe-jetbrains/src/main/kotlin/com/moe/services/MoeMessageDispatcher.kt, in the "DECISIONS" branch (about :455-464).

Today the branch does `decisionsArray.map { MoeJson.parseDecision(it.asJsonObject) }`. One non-object element throws, the catch logs it, and nothing publishes. After a reconnect, one bad row would then leave every card missing, which is this bug again.

Replace it, inside the existing try, with:
```kotlin
val decisions = decisionsArray.mapNotNull { element ->
    val obj = element?.takeIf { it.isJsonObject }?.asJsonObject ?: return@mapNotNull null
    if (obj.get("id").stringOrNull().isNullOrBlank()) return@mapNotNull null
    MoeJson.parseDecision(obj)
}
val skipped = decisionsArray.size() - decisions.size
if (skipped > 0) log.warn("Skipped $skipped malformed DECISIONS entries")
publishDecisions(decisions)
```

Design rules:
- Malformed means one of: not a JSON object, or no non-blank JSON-string `id`.
- Use the strict `stringOrNull()` reader (:41). Never use `safeAsString()`: it throws UnsupportedOperationException on an object id and IllegalStateException on an array id.
- Use log.warn, never log.error. In headless JUnit, error throws an AssertionError.
- The warn names only the count. No payload content goes into logs.

Error handling: keep the existing try/catch and its "Failed to parse DECISIONS payload" warn as the backstop for anything unforeseen. Keep the payload and array early returns byte-identical.

Leave these unchanged: the DECISION_PROPOSED and DECISION_RESOLVED branches and MoeJson.parseDecision (DoD 4). Step 1's dispatcher tests 1-4 then go green.
implementationPlan.note: Replaced DECISIONS all-or-nothing map with approved mapNotNull: non-objects and missing/blank/non-string ids skipped via strict stringOrNull; warn logs skipped count only. Early returns, catch, parseDecision and DECISION_PROPOSED/RESOLVED unchanged. Step 1 supplies regression tests and RED evidence. GREEN verification is consolidated into step 4's full Windows gate per plan; not claiming it run yet.

implementationPlan.description:
Refill the decision map on every connection open. This is in moe-jetbrains/src/main/kotlin/com/moe/toolwindow/ChatPanel.kt, in the stateListener's `onStatus` (about :214-219). Inside `if (connected) { ... }`, add `service.requestDecisions()` right after `service.requestChannels()`. This mirrors ActivityLogPanel.onStatus (:80-84).

Why this is enough:
- MoeProjectService publishes onStatus(true) once per socket open, at MoeProjectService.kt:352, after `connected = true`. That covers the first connect and every reconnect, and MoeCommandSender.ensureConnected passes at that point.
- The daemon answers GET_DECISIONS with the whole decision set (packages/moe-daemon/src/server/WebSocketServer.ts:1159-1162, state.getDecisions()).
- onDecisions (:271-277) already clears and refills decisionsMap and calls refreshMessages().
- setMessages also renders through refreshMessages(), which does the card lookup at :688. So existing `[Decision Proposed]` messages become Approve/Reject cards whichever of MESSAGES or DECISIONS arrives first, with no channel switch.

Keep the constructor's `service.requestChannels()` and `service.requestDecisions()` (:299-300). They serve a panel built while the socket is already open, which gets no later onStatus(true). Keep the `if (disposed) return` guard.

Change nothing else: Approve and Reject, onDecisionProposed and onDecisionResolved, the channel combo, ChatChannelSelection, and pins stay as they are (DoD 4). The step 1 ChatPanelConnectTest then goes green.

Error handling: requestDecisions goes through ensureConnected. If the socket closes before the call, the call is dropped with a warning and the next open re-requests, so no retry loop is needed.
implementationPlan.note: Added requestDecisions immediately after requestChannels on connected status; disposed guard and constructor requests unchanged. Confirmed open publishes connected=true once after socket connection, requestDecisions sends GET_DECISIONS, reply returns whole set, and existing onDecisions clear/refill/refresh renders pre-existing messages in either arrival order. Headless source guard recorded RED in step 1; GREEN consolidated in step 4.

planningNotes.approachesConsidered:
Option A was chosen: onStatus(connected=true) sends GET_DECISIONS, as ActivityLogPanel does. It is a one-line change, the daemon returns the whole decision set, and onDecisions already clears, refills and re-renders.

Option B was rejected: carrying the snapshot's decisions through MoeJson.parseState and Models.MoeState into ChatPanel.onState. It touches Models, MoeJson and ChatPanel, and the 3 s GET_STATE refresh would either call refreshMessages every tick (UI churn and scroll jumps) or need an equality guard.

The malformed-entry DoD clause is applied to the DECISIONS reply that Option A relies on. Today one bad entry drops the whole list.
planningNotes.codebaseInsights:
- MoeProjectService.kt:352 is the only publishStatus(true, "Connected"). It fires once per socket open, after connected=true.
- MoeCommandSender.ensureConnected (:26-33) drops commands sent before the socket opens. That is why the constructor's requestDecisions is lost at IDE start: the panel is built before service.connect().
- MoeMessageDispatcher has two string readers. safeAsString (:37) throws on objects and arrays; stringOrNull (:41) is strict and never throws.
- PINS keeps all-or-nothing semantics for a malformed entry (MoeMessageDispatcherPinsTest). DECISIONS deliberately differs, per this task's DoD ("skipped").
- Source-guard idiom: DoneColumnClearTest.source(). Dispatcher harness: MoeMessageDispatcherPinsTest and MoeMessageDispatcherAccountsTest.
planningNotes.risks:
- Do not move or remove the constructor's two requests. A panel built while the socket is already open gets no onStatus(true).
- Do not use safeAsString for the id check: it throws on an object or array id.
- Use log.warn, not log.error (headless AssertionError).
- The shared-tree red-file hazard applies only if the attempt runs in shared mode.
- From WSL the gradle gate is Windows-only; label it so in the evidence.
